$comment: Smoke-harness baseline. Recapture DELIBERATELY (see README) — never auto-overwrite, or a regression silently becomes the new normal. Elapsed times are indicative, not assertions: they depend on machine, network and model. The assertion COUNTS are the meaningful part — a count dropping means a check silently stopped running.
known_intermittency: Across 4 full runs, 2 were clean and 2 had exactly one scenario fail. One cause was found and fixed (banner tail-window too small for a wrapped STUCK block). The other was a prd-run failure under concurrency that did not reproduce in isolation (6/6 solo) nor on the following full run. Suspected contention from 3 concurrent claude sessions. Re-run a failing scenario in isolation before treating it as a regression.
